title: ATDD issue body (#1223 — the issue artifact joins the author substrate)
description: Canonical schema for an ATDD GitHub issue body. Peer of convention-node/gate/relationship/scope. The `required` list is the set of section HEADINGS (verbatim `## …` H2 / `### …` H3 markdown strings) an issue body must contain — exactly the H2 sections of PARENT-ISSUE-TEMPLATE.md (minus the optional `## Rule Wiring`) plus the two mandatory H3 subsections `### Graph Context` / `### Mirror Across Agents` that #682 lifted from advisory to mandatory. Modeling `required` as the heading strings (rather than abstract keys) keeps the schema, the `atdd author issue` generator, and the coach E019 gate mechanically drift-checked against one another (C011). The `status`/`type` properties carry the Metadata enums; `status` derives its vocabulary from src/atdd/coach/conventions/phase_machine.convention.yaml (single shared vocabulary — the #1203 State-Store work-item record reuses it, no fork).

## Issue Metadata.description: Metadata table: Date, Status (enum), Type (enum), Branch, Archetypes, Train, Feature.

## Scope.description: In Scope / Out of Scope / Dependencies / Done-when.

## Context.description: Problem Statement, User Impact, Root Cause.

## Architecture.description: Design, including the two mandatory H3 subsections below.

### Graph Context.description: How this issue sits in the dependency/issue graph (mandatory, #682).

## Phases.description: Sequenced phases with deliverables and files.

## Notes.description: Additional context that does not fit elsewhere.

status.description: Work-item phase. Vocabulary is the single shared phase-machine vocabulary (src/atdd/coach/conventions/phase_machine.convention.yaml); the #1203 State-Store work-item record reuses these exact values (no fork).
